escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection (Multiple CVEs)
escalations.impact: Template injection → Remote Code Execution in any system using backend templates
escalations.fix: Upgrade handlebars to ≥4.7.10; trace transitive chain via Jest ecosystem

escalations.title: proxy-addr IPv4-Mapped IPv6 Spoofing
escalations.impact: Bypass of IP-based access control → Unauthorized access to admin/internal endpoints
escalations.fix: Upgrade proxy-addr to ≥2.0.8; review deployed IP allowlists

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read/Execution
escalations.impact: Local/network exposure of source code, secrets, and arbitrary code execution during testing
escalations.fix: Upgrade Vitest to ≥5.0.5; disable --ui flag in CI pipelines

escalations.title: Tinypool Prototype Pollution → Worker RCE
escalations.impact: RCE in test worker processes, data exfiltration, build pipeline compromise

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to Specifications/
p2_findings.summary: Enforcer only scans Plans/*/requirements.md; never validates any Specifications/*.md file. Future specs added with no companion plan will have zero enforcement silently.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add --specs mode accepting an explicit spec file + implementation dir pair

p2_findings.title: Three-system split (Source/, portal/, platform/) undocumented
p2_findings.summary: Project silently splits across three implementation targets but CLAUDE.md and specs contain no documentation of this split. New agents risk cross-contamination: implementing portal/ FRs in Source/.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add # Implemented-in: portal/ headers to specs; add system topology section to CLAUDE.md

p2_findings.title: Jest ecosystem — multiple cascading CVEs
p2_findings.summary: jest-message-util contains information disclosure; micromatch has DoS via glob expansion

p2_findings.title: brace-expansion DoS (multiple variants)
p2_findings.summary: Multiple DoS vectors: recursion, unbounded expansion, process hang via zero-step sequences

p2_findings.title: React Router open redirect (multiple XSS/redirect CVEs)
p2_findings.summary: Multiple open redirect vulnerabilities allow phishing redirects and XSS payload injection

p2_findings.title: PostCSS arbitrary file read via sourceMappingURL
p2_findings.summary: PostCSS follows sourceMappingURL comments allowing attacker-controlled CSS to read arbitrary .map files

p2_findings.title: Browserslist memory DoS / prototype pollution
p2_findings.summary: Unbounded cache growth causes OOM crashes; untrusted stats file triggers prototype pollution

p2_findings.title: Nanoid loops indefinitely — DoS in ID generation
p2_findings.summary: Non-secure generators loop with negative size; integer overflow in ID generation

p2_findings.title: form-data CRLF injection
p2_findings.summary: CRLF injection in multipart field names/filenames allows request smuggling and header injection

p2_findings.title: source-map-js DoS via indexed offsets
p2_findings.summary: Event-loop DoS through indexed source-map section offsets blocks build pipeline

p2_findings.title: WebSocket (ws) memory exhaustion DoS
p2_findings.summary: Memory exhaustion from tiny fragments/data chunks in WebSocket messages

p2_findings.title: Vite esbuild CORS bypass
p2_findings.summary: Vite dev server allows any website to bypass CORS and read local dev responses

p2_findings.title: @vitest/mocker path traversal
p2_findings.summary: Path traversal in redirect mock allows arbitrary file reads during test execution

p3_findings.title: Duplicate test files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage
p3_findings.summary: Root-level and tests/pages/ versions both exist; neither is a strict subset; risk of divergence and false confidence
p3_findings.recommendation: Delete root-level versions; keep tests/pages/ versions (newer, more comprehensive)

p3_findings.title: Undocumented eslint-disable in 2 production files
p3_findings.summary: react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressed without rationale in DependencyPicker.tsx and useWorkItems.ts; could mask stale closure bugs
p3_findings.recommendation: Replace bare suppression with documented reasoning comment

p3_findings.title: js-yaml RCE / ReDoS
p3_findings.summary: Contains ReDoS and potential code execution vulnerabilities

p3_findings.title: baseline-browser-mapping DoS on invalid input
p3_findings.summary: Process termination on invalid input causes denial of service in build pipeline

p3_findings.title: esbuild CORS bypass (via Vite)
p3_findings.summary: esbuild dev server allows cross-origin requests; resolved by Vite upgrade

p3_findings.title: @remix-run/router open redirect
p3_findings.summary: Protocol-relative URL reinterpretation enables open redirect; resolved by React Router upgrade

p3_findings.title: body-parser silent limit bypass
p3_findings.summary: Request body size limits can be bypassed silently; potential DoS / memory exhaustion
p3_findings.recommendation: Upgrade body-parser to ≥1.20.6 (via Express ecosystem upgrade)

p3_findings.title: @babel/core arbitrary file read
p3_findings.summary: Arbitrary file read vulnerability in Babel core; affects build-time processing

p4_findings.title: FR-TMP-008 not traced in platform/
p4_findings.summary: Dockerfile.worker prerequisites (FR-TMP-008) untraced because Dockerfiles don't carry comments in enforcer scan scope

p4_findings.title: Silent .catch() in api/client.ts error path
p4_findings.summary: response.json().catch(() => ({})) discards parse error context; outer throw propagates failure so acceptable but borderline

p4_findings.title: 3 low-severity dependency CVEs (informational)
p4_findings.summary: 3 low-severity CVEs across backend and frontend dependency trees; no immediate action required

cross_reference_map.single_fix: Upgrade Jest to ≥30.5.2 — resolves handlebars transitive pull-in, jest CVEs, brace-expansion DoS
Upgrade vitest to ≥5.0.5 — resolves vitest file read, tinypool RCE, nanoid loops, ws DoS, @vitest/mocker path traversal
Add system topology documentation to CLAUDE.md + Implemented-in headers to specs + --specs mode to traceability enforcer
Upgrade Vite to ≥8.3.4 and PostCSS to ≥8.5.23 — resolves CORS bypass, esbuild CORS, PostCSS file read
